craft_notes: Sthāyin: chain. Sanskrit-first: seven-step chain kept (three lines for seven links). Rows: 3. Close: crowned. Rejected: trimming Dānavas — killed: as-is. Read aloud: linking cadence.

lines: Rāma to king in seven falling steps.
